read.en: Sandisk rose 1.4% on Oct 26 to $1,255.58, trading between $1,229.00 and $1,287.84. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,299.6), 10-day ($1,344.9), 30-day ($1,577.8) and 100-day ($1,620.7) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($1,240.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,406.99), and RSI is 32.

The close reclaimed the $1,244.6 Oct 22 low, support again. Resistance is $1,276–1,287.8 (Oct 15 low, Oct 26 high), then $1,299.6–1,300 (5-day, Oct 23 high) and $1,325 (Jul 17 low). Support is $1,240.9–1,244.6 (200-day, Oct 22 low), then $1,229 (Oct 23 and 26 lows) and $998 (Jul 29 low). A close above $1,288 would target $1,300–1,325; a close below $1,229 would open $1,000.
